To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The income gap between the rich and the poor in China is increasing; (2) Income inequality has a negative effect on well-being, but this effect is not statistically significant; (3) Income inequality has no effect on the subjective well-being of the poor; (4) Income inequality has an adverse impact on the subjective well being of the rich, but the magnitude of this effect is not significant; (5) Government action and social assistance can alleviate the adverse effects of income inequality
